sgrig pa po'i gtam/rang re'i bod du dmangs khrod kha rgyun du ring nas 'jags pa'i gtam dpe ha cang mang po yod kyang de sngon phyogs bsdus kyis par du btab pa byung med pas/— sde dge bskal bzang dbang 'dus sku dam pa dedang hor /spang bsod nams dpal 'bar rnam gnyis kyi phyag na yod pa'i gtam dpe'i zin deb gzhir bzung thog 'di gar sngon bsdus kyi gtam dpe nas kha gsab byas rjes ka kha'i go rim ltar phyogs bsgrigs kyis par du btab pa ma zad/ da phan bod du gtam dper dbye ba 'di yin zhes med par kha dpe'am gtam rgyud yang na tshiṭa bcad la soṭa pa gang bder brjod pa la rnam gnyis kyi dkangs 'char du ri lda klu skyel lta bur rgyun 'jags dzig bsdus kyi gtam dpe dang / mi gcig byung na chung nas byung / rta gcig byung nas rte'u nas yong lta bur nyams myong don bsdus kyigtam dpe/ ri bong cal 'drogs lta bur gtam rgyud don bsdus kyi gtam dpe nas khag gsum tsam du dbyi dgos tshul la gzhigs na dpe deb 'ad nang du 'khod pa ni nyams myong don bsdus kyi gtam dpe 'ba' zhig yin la rgyun ldan 'tsho ba'i nang du'ang spyod go che bas par thengs dang po'i deb grangs kyis spyi tshogs kyi dgos mkho ma tshi8sa par da res bskyar du par 'debs byas pa dang chabs cig kha gsab kyang mi nyung

ganka ra bzhin du drang dgos/ /ka rdo bzhin du brtan dgos/ /marma pa la nye ring med/ /lhaso / miX sri rgyu pa gyur cig /ka bar bsdo ra nas gdung rir brda btab/ /ka ra med na gur mi dbub/ /'bangs dang bral na don mi 'grub/ /ka bar 'jag ma'i lhan pa / /ka lis gnam chu bsgags/ /sgal tshigs bye mas khengs/ /ṭ+wāṃ ((sna lhashā /lha/ ༵ pa/sna shāshā pa//ga/ / ‘na
kun dang mthun pa mi chos rtsa ba yon/ /kug kug na chag 'gro/ /rathen 'then na chad 'gro/ /mar leb sgur gsum gyi bdag po las/ /lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdom pa dga'/ /ker ker phyag dang sgar sgur gyi zhu 'bul/ /ko gru snga btsan dang bka' shog rjes btsan/ /ko ba gcig nas dras pa'i rgyun bu dang / /sha khog gcig nas gtubs pa'i tig ga /ko kau g.yag la re mi dgos/ /rgya tsha glang gi ko ba yod/ /ko ba skam pos skud mi len/ /sgang ma rlon pas chu mi len/ /ko gla sprod rgyu dang / /rgyab chu brgal rgyu/ /2
ko ba chu la sbong ba'i srol yod kyang / /lda chu la sungs ba'i bangs srol med/ /kong po klu nang du slebs dus/ /a ngos pha yul mi dran/ /kong po ba 'dra 'dra yin kyang / /mar ltang 'dra 'dra bkyag mi thub/ /dka' las skya bas brgyabs/ /longs spyod gzar bus btang / /dka' las sdon la rgyobs/ /sgyid po rjes la gtong / /dka' ba dang du len/ /lci ba rgyab tu 'khur/ /dka' ba'i las gcig ma byas na/ /zhim po'i zas gcig ga la rag /dka' spyad bzod thub na/ /bya ba los kyis sgrub/ /
dka' ngal che dus g.yo zol mi byed/ /nya bde skyid byung skabs bag phebasabya dgos/ /dka' ba'i brag dang ma thug na/ /bde ba'i spang la slebs mi thub/ /dka' las rang gis brgyabs/ /longs spyod mi yis btang / /dka' las brgyabs pa'i dka' chang dang / /mdzo pho bsad pa'i sdig gla/ /dka' las ma brgyabs pa ra dngo sa grub ga nas/ yong / /dka' ba'i dus su grogs po bzang ngan rtogs/ /'dam rdzab nang du rta po'i shed shugs shes/ /dkar dkar snam bu'i tshos ṇ+ṭha/dog red ra na tob /sa/ /khra khra tshon ris kyi g.yab gos ma red/ /dkar mo nas kyi gong thang cad tsharan/ /gro dang sran ma'i nang thang shod ma dgos/ /4
dkar yol chag kyang ri mo blo la ngos/ /dkar po gyen 'ded dang / /nag po bur 'ded/ /dkar po btab sar dkar po yong / /nag po btab sar nag po yong / /dkon mchog gis lam gang bstan dang / /byis pas khyi gang bkag las med 4// /dkon gnyer phyis bdar mkhas drag na/ /gser sku rag la btang yong ngo / /dkyil du bzhag na phra 'dra/ /zur du bzhag na rgyan 'dra/ /bka' drin la bsam shes med par/ /drin lan la log 'jal/ /bka' shog 7/ ma chod rgyal po'i phyag rtsa dang / /mna' ma na ma chod a ra 'i sgo rtsa/ /
bka' lda rje gcad pa dang / /gsung spru gri ngar ma/ /bka' lan sngon por zhu la na ljang khu/ /bka' shog rgyab la mi shog /bkol ma shes yon tan phan med red/ /'debs ma shes sa zhing stong pa red/ /bkyags na spor sang / /bzhag na ldid mdog /b+thā po/ /bkra shis pa'i glu len sar/ /ltas ngan pa'i sdug skad/ /bkra shis pa'i bro 'khrab sar/ /ltas ngan pa'i zhabs bro ma rgyag /bkrol long med nas 'bregs/ /nyan long med nas bshad/ /6
rkang bzhi la kha dang / /g.yu chung sgo rgyab/ /rkang lag phra por/ /'khur rtsa ldid po/ / rkang pa rgyag sa lag pas 'tshol/ /gom pa rgyag dus mig gis ltos/ /rkang 'og gi re'u/ /dpral bar 'phar ba /rkang pa༄ la ma reg par/ /nya yo lag pas 'dzin thabs med/ /rku mi chag gsung mi dpon po dang / /rgyu mnangs chen dgos mi dpon zo red/ /rku rgyus yod kyis byed/ /thun rgyus med kyis shod/ /tun ma nang la bzhag / ‘sgo lcags phyi la brgyab/ /7
kun ma la dpag pa'i chog shes/ /tun ma a yag gis btu sa/ /khag 'a gag la bzhag / jirkun ma kha skyengs kyis mi gsod/ /khyi kha skyengs kyis chu 'bung / /rkun jag bzung na gte po zungs/ /rtswa ngan bkog na rtsa ba 'don/ /6na ma la dpa' dar dang / /spyang ke la tshe thar/ /kun por rdzu 'phrul gyi stobasayod kyangan/bdag por ye shes kyi spyan yod/ /kun po g.yag la dga'/— /bla ma ro la dga'/ / / ཿrkun pos g.yag la bzhon/ / (ga yag mdzos rta rgyug btang / /8de
kun pos khrid pa'i ba mo/ /rkun ma rkun gzog che/ /—rkun ma mi shor ba dgos/ / rkun rtsad ḍi chod pa dga'/ /kun ma ham chen gyis mi gsod/ /rkun ma sangs rgyas gar yod mi shes/ /rkun ma lang shor mi gral la mi tshud/ /kun ma la jag ba shor/ /rku sems la bcangag na thob rgyun mi chad/ /rkub kha bral la mi tshud/ / ḍa ru rnga gral la mi tshud/ /rkyang kha dkar bzung nas blo rta byas/ /'brong bre ser bzung nas sgo zog byas/ /
myang pho hreng la chu mi rag mi pho hrang mi tshe mi 'khyol/ /rkyang la 4 shor na/ /yas so can gyi bstan par gnod/ /rkyang lho la shi yang / /mgo byang la lta/ /brkyangs na mda' nyan pa/ /bkug na gzhu nyan pa/ /myal khog chen po'i zhabs ra/ /rkyal gog mthil rnal nang du/ /rtsam pa blugs dogs med/ /lkugs pas hra lam rmis pa bzhin/ /brjod du med pa'i nyams shig shar/ /lkugs pas spyang mdog byas spru/ /mngon gsal gzhan las dod pa/ /10
lkugs pas lkugs rtags/ ma bstan na/ /rgyal po'i sras dang rnar nyen yod/ /lhags pa la shes rab kyi lce dang / /long ba la ye shes kyi mig /lkog tu spyod ngan byas na/ /nam zhig rdzun rkub brdol yong / /lko ga kha btsan po la'ang gtong / /ngo dga' lkugs pa la'ang rgyud/ /skad cha mdun la shod/ /lcang lo rgyab la g.yugs/ /ciskad cha bsam nas shod/ /rtsam pa 'gam nas mid/ /ska rags lham sgrog dam na dga'/ /kha 'u da sna lud med na mdzes/ /shad seng ge dkar ṅgā che yang /phan sgo khyi nag po thogs/ / 11
skad cha ring na mi mi dga'/ /dbyug pa ring na khyi mi dga'/ /skad cha snyan po brag la jibazad na/ /zag cha snyan po tshur la thos/ /skad cha mang na 'khrug 'gro/ /skud pa ring na chad 'gro/ /skad cha mang na skyon dang / /za rgyu mang na nad/ /skad char cho mi 'dug /zhud par dbugs mi 'dug /skam po ldas rdungs/ /rlon pa gis gcod/ /skabs bzang 'khel dus 'gyangs mi nyan/ /skam po'i lag rtsed de/ / rlon pa'i chu nang du mi thon/ /12
skar ma lnga yi a sgor/ /su yis btags kyang thogs shig /skar ma re res nam re bskyal/ /de nas tho rengs skar chen shar/ /skas ka med par thog khar mi slobs/ sdiskas kor srang gang sprad na/ /thog khar ci 'dzog /sku nyi ma'i nang du bzhugs/ /gsung grib ma'i cang du khyab/ /sku ya rabs la/ /spyod pa ma rabs/ /sku che la ri rgyal kun po dang / /thugs chung la ab bra'i ril ma/ /sku stod la bstod ra dang / /sku smad la smud ra/ /13
sku lus gcig la bkod pa brgya/ /dud pa ring po lam la zad/ /mi tshe ring po stong par zad/ /dud pa gcig gis ras gos mi nyan/ /shing sdong gcig gis nags tshal mi nyan/ /ske de las ring na yi dwags dang / /gting de las ring na dmyal ba/ /ske khyer nas zhags pa nyo ba dang / /rdza khyer nas rdo nyo ba/ /ske 'dod la lda ba mi 'dod/ /ske 'bregs nas dasog mar byil byil/ /sked rags kyis rta thub/ /lham sgrog gis lug thub/ /jisked rags las sne 'dzar ring ba/ /14
sked rags ma bshig dpyid mgo'i gdeng tshod//skom dus chang gis ma phan na/ /rdza ma'i thim bu brnal kyang brdol/ /skya ga khra mo'i tshang gcig nas/ /ma khra bu nag yong don med//skya ga la mdzes pa dang //thang shing la spam pa/ /skya mi dang rkang thang 'grul mi gcig /phyug po dang sprang po sems mi gcig /skya rengs nam mkha' ma langs par/ /khri gdugs nyi ma shar thabs med/ /skya ga mdzes kyang mna' ma mi yong / /bu mo mdzes kyang yon tan ldan dgos/ /skya gas rgyal po byas na/ /gling kha skad kyis brgyang yong / /15
skyag pa satong khar ma ba/togs/ /gsang spyod dran mi yong / /skyag rdzun rlung las tsha ba/ /skyag ro chu las sla ba/ /skyag pa skam po chus khyer kyang / /sde pa gzhung gis ko ba mi gtong / /skyag rdzun skad cha'i 5smo pyo gas/ /mna' skyel bsam dan rig/ba ched/ /skyag thun dpon gyis bshad/ /nyes pa r+yā /yog la bkal/ /skyid kyis sdug nyos/ /mar gyis tshil nyos/ /skyid sdug zhu sa dpon po dang / /grang ltogs shod sa pha ma/ //kho
skyed pa'i re ba byas kyang / /sdug gi 'phrang las mi thar/ /skyed 7 'i kha bshad de/ /sdug po'i skyo rogs mi yong / /skyed thag ring ba'i thabs dang / /sdug thag thung ba'i blo dgos/ /skyid snga la sgug 'o nga dang / /sdug ngo la sa ngas dus yod / /skyid po sha pho'i ra la sa ring / /sdug po dka pho'i brun la sa mang / /skyid nyi ma gnyis la yar du sa med/ /sdug phun pa gnyis la sel dus yod/ /skyid kyi spyo pho 4 nyam 〈zhon/ /sdug gi khur po mnyam 'khur/ /skyid na nam cha kha'i bya yang 'khor/ /sdug na rang gi bu nga nga bros/ /17
ṣ+yo da la kha'i rtswa la mnyam za dang / /sdug sdo mo'i chu la mnyam 'bung / /6da na ja chang mnyam 'thung / /sdud na rang sems gso rogs/ /skyid na mnyam skyed dang / /sdug na mnyam sdug /cad por nyis rtsegs med pa'i/ /ñcā ga por sum rtsegs/ /skyid po rang gis ma byas na/ /sdug po mi yis gtong / /skyed dus mgo 'phang ma mtho/ /sdug dus rang sems ma zhum/ /cad dus rta la bzhon na rkub na/ /sdug dus kha sug log na glu btang / /skyed 'dod na rgas po'i chung ma byed/ /18
skyid sdug gan de man 'brel/ /sgyid sdug sgang gshong mi snyoms/ /snyad sdug legs nyes gang byung yang / /blo rtse gcig la bsgril ba dgos/ /skyed thag ring ba las/ /sdug thag thung ba dga'/ /skyid mi sgyid rang gi bsam blo red/ /dro mi dro nyi ma'i lag la yod/ /skyed dus mi dang bstun dgos/ /sdug dus rang mgo thon dgos/ /skyid re sdug re ma myangs na/ /cad sdug dbye ba 'byed mi shes/ /6da dus dga' spro mnyam gtong / /sdug dus mig chu mnyam gtong / /
skyid sdug gang yin gzhas kyis shes/ /lung pa gang yin skad kyis shes/ /sgyin pa chu yin yang 'jal dgos/ /skyin pa chu yin yang sla ru ma thongs/ /smyur mo 'ig dang ma 'phrad na/ /mngar mo thams cad cang cang red/ /rgyug bro ya nga a ma'i lto duphor red/ /myu nga dzis smyung shar phya res ma byed/ /mchu to dmar pe cha red/ /skye sa mtho po la /ba'i 'jag ma/ /mtho yang mi phan sgo rgyab kyi phyags ma/ /8 bo kha mang la bden pa'i tshig yod/ /skye bo ngan par lab gleng mang / /cachu bo lhag mar 'dam snyigs mang / /20
skye don med pa'i shing gcig la/ /bab don med pa'i bya gcig babs/ /skye ba yag ste skyid mo dang / /gdong pa bzang ste khrum khrum red/ /skye thengs gcig la shi thengs gnyis/ /skyes pa'i mi la grags pa'i gtam dgos/ /byas pa'i las la grub pa'i mtha' dgos/ /skyes ma thag pa'i pe'us/ /stag la spag ngo mi shes/ /skyo dus mi phan chung 'dris khyi la sa los/ /ltogs dus mi phan zas kyis ci zhig byed/ /skyon yod de 'drogs/ / sgal chad de 'phag /skra rtse rlung gis bskyod kyang skra rtsa ka li la 'byar/ / ‘skra bzhar zhor la kha spu rdzob/sa/ / khu1
skrangs pas 'byar len/ /sbangs pas chu len/ /bskal pa chags pa'i gangs ri las/ /rlung gis ded pa'i bye ri ma red/ /bskal pa'i yur bu la srid pa'i chu drangs pa las// /dpe ngan gsar 'jugs byas pa min/ /bskal pa bzang po'i ja 'dren de/ /dus tshad ngan pa'i khral la gyur/ /bskos pa'i las la zlog thabs med/ /dpral ba'i gnyer ma phyis thabs med/ /bskos pa'i mi dang btsugs pa'i shing / /mngags pa'i mi dang 'phangs pa'i mda'/ /bskos pa'i mi de btsugs pa 'dra/ /btsugs pa'i shing de skyes pa 'dra/ /22
khakha ba babs pas yag /kha shul nyi ma dro/ /kha ba babs na nyi srib dang / /nyi ma shar na phu mda' med/ /kha btags ring ni gang yong / /dkar kha gtsang ba yag 'dug /kha gtam g.yu 'brug skad las che/ /lag len nam mkha'i 'ja' ltar yal/ /kha bshad la nyi ma shar/ /lag len la mun pa rub/ //ba stong nang gi lce stong / /lag stong nang gi phyag stong / /23
kha bshad chu yi m+bu ba/ /lag len gser gyi thigs pa/ /kha mkhas pas bu lon gsos dus med/ /rgyu 'dod pas sdig pa dag dus med/ /rikha bde can gyis ci shed dang / /dwangs kha can gyis ci za/1 /kha bde po mi yi dpon po dang / /lag bde po mi yi g.yog po yin/ /kha lang la 'or ba'i glu chung de/ /pha a ma she yang lhang lhang len/ /kha pho sngon dang rlag len rjes/ /kha bde mos mi tshe mi 'khyol/ /kha la pad+ma'i lha lang bzhengs/ /cagating la dag/ ru'i gcu phur nyar/ /24
kha 'jam tra /ting nag dug gi me to ka /phyi 'jam nang lhub bod bu'i ong ril/ /kha khras khras pags pa'i 'then phyogs/ /dga' mi dga' snying gi rtsa ba/ / kha dang khog pa drang po gyis/ /lus dang lag pa gtsang ma gyis/ /kha mang rgyad kyi rtsa ba/ /bya mang byur gyi sna 'dren/ /kha che ba las /nyan chung ba dga'/ /kha kha rog bsdad na kha mchu med/ /mgo rum du bcug na lhags pa med/ /kha mchu yul la med pa dang / /ca ba rang la ma zug pa dgos/ /kha mchu mi 'dod gnam rdo sgor 5/ /bu lon mi 'dod sngon cagyi lan chags/ /25
kha mchu zhag la lus na pho las mo mkhas/ :/ba mchu dngul gyis rgyal pa la/ /bden pa dgos yas mi 'dug kha chad rgyag mkhan kha red/ /ri mo 'bri mkhan lag red/ /kha sna'i bar la rdzun lab/ /mdzub mo'i bar la ri bkang/ /kha nas tshig shor yu ba thung / /yu ba thung la 'ju sa med/ /kha 'thab bar la lce mchu sdem/ / rdo rdung bar la mdzog mgo sdem/ /kha mchu to zur gsum gyis rdzun ma lab/ /lag mdzub mo bcu yis rku ma byed/ /kha bsangs na go bde/ /nam gsal na 'gro bde/ /26
kha pho rus med kyang gong nga / /ske cas pa med kyang krong krong / /kha rin po che lus dal du chugs/ /kha ྅ la bu yod kyang / /dbang thang la nu ma bskams/ /kha rog bsdad na bu mo lhags ma zer/ /gnas lugs bshad na bu mo'i 'pher sha zer/ /kha ta zho bsnyal bsnyal la/ /chag sgo chang langs langs/ /kha log la phyi log bya rgyu med/ /lam log la phyi log bya rgyu yod/ /kha rma gso dka'/ /lag rma gso bde/ /slo ta nag po'i sdig sgrib kyis/ /ngang pa ser po 'dam la zug /22
kha rlangs shig gisadros/ —/bya grib cig gisa'akhyags/ /kha so gcigaca gisami yi zhing bzas nag / — kha so yongs kyis 'gro ba'i lam bu bkag /kha zas spang nas bzas/ /ril ma nags su btang / /kha tig gi ro ma myangs na/ /mngar mo'i ro ngo mi shes/ /kha mngar lhags pa'i sems la gsal/ /byams sdang byis pa'i yid la yod/ /kha la za 'dod na/ /lag pas las ka byed/ /kha za 'dod kyi tshogs 'khor dang / /glu gtong 'dod kyi mgur/ /kha thabs kyis me 9 gsos par/ /blo rig gi mang ja/ /38
khri dog dgon sar lo legs na/ /'dzam bu gling la ltas ngan/ / kha ya rabs kyis min min/ /lag ma rabs kyis rkyong tsam rkyong tsam/ /kha gang bltas la bkra mi shis/ /rkub gang bltas la rtswa mi skye/ / kha shas bla ma bsams/ /kha shas gtor ma bsams/ /kha rnar lam rnar gnyis de/ /nyes rdung gzed pa'i gzhi ma yin/ /kha ba mgo thog tu babs na/ /rbad mnas g.yab g.yab/ /kha dkar rkyang la kha lo med/ /bre ser 'brong la sna lo med/ /kha sa rna yag mchong sar/ /de ring pa phas mchongs/ /
kha gnam la lta ring / /rkub pho rog gis 'drug/ /kha ba nyin mtshan bca brgyad babs kyang / /byi'u tso ka khra mo'i skad la 'gyur ba med/ /kha zur bzhun mar bzhu rdzas/ /ṭam kha brgya las 3 ga pa/ / rikha nang gi rma kha kha nang gsos/ /khyim nang gi kha rtsod khyam nang (1/ /kha 'tshigs pa lag pas ma bzod/ /kha so pags pas mi 'dum/ /kha lpags 'ub sul mi sdud/ /kha bu ram las rmangar ba /gting sol ba las gnag pa/ /kha bde pos bshad na ri mgo 'dzog 'jog /lag bde pos mnyas na rdza kyog skad pa ldom ldem/ /30
kha lag gtsang ma'i mchod pa de/ / —dam tshig gtsang man gnas lda ngaphul/ /kha gcig la khog pa mi gcig /sngas gcig la rmi lam mi gcig /kha gcig lce gnyis/ /gtam gcig don gnyis/ /kha dbang yod kyang rang dbang med/ /mdzod khang yod kyang lde mig med/ /kha 'cham gros 'grigs gser ñci rnar pu/ /kha thor dkug shing snying gi ral gri/ /kha bal las 'jam/ /kha dang kha spu dbye 'byed/ /rnar dang bu tsha dbye 'byed/ /ji —kha kha rog )sdo(1 na kha drag yo / /mgo mgo gtum brgyab na mgo tog yo da/ /tshong/rima/—
kha che rung sna ba'i 'og tu yod/ /chu che rung zam pa'i 'og la yod/ /kha che'i kha la ma blta/ /kha che'i lto la bltos/ /kha mchu kha yis brgyab pa la/ /kub khyod sdug bskum btsum nas sdod/ /kha yag gi kha ma blta/ /ngo yag gi ngo ma blta/ /kha dang khog pa drang po dgos/ /glo ba rgyu ma gtsang ma dgos/ /kha la so med na lce gu yangs/ /kha mar grong pa'i dkrug shing / /bya mang mi kha'i gzhi ma/ /kha 'tsher gyi skyob mi thub/ /dar ra 'thung pas skom mi sod/ /:2
